The selected simple eating responses retain their infinitive/finite endings, regional deaspiration and vowels. l-extended eastern responses are analyzed with the Bhojpuri khāil family; western eat-plus-take compounds remain separate. Inter-Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: kai.
